summary: Hudbay Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K via a Material Change Report announcing the closing of its acquisition of Arizona Sonoran Copper Company Inc. via court-approved plan of arrangement. Hudbay acquired all outstanding Arizona Sonoran shares not already owned, with former shareholders receiving 0.242 Hudbay share per Arizona Sonoran share. Hudbay issued 46,794,082 shares as consideration. Arizona Sonoran shares were delisted from TSX and OTCQX. The transaction positions Hudbay to consolidate copper assets. Watch for integration milestones and any post-closing adjustments or shareholder litigation.
